scope.operation: Validate DRW_Surface runtime subtypes at adapter capture, serializer, and DXF output dispatch boundaries.
behavior: dx_iface::addSurface accepts the six concrete surface types only when each eType matches; null, unknown, base-only-with-derived-tag, and mismatched concrete subtype callbacks fail typed capture without retaining an entity.
dxfRW::writeSurface checks the runtime subtype before reading subtype-specific fields. A base DRW_Surface remains valid for PLANESURFACE to preserve the historical plane representation.
The concrete DXF adapter marks an eType/runtime-type mismatch as a write error instead of silently omitting the entity and publishing a partial drawing.
